verdict.rationale: The only installation evidence is a curl-piped shell script (`curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh`). That is a vendor install script, not a standard package manager such as Homebrew, apt, winget or pip. The Python and JavaScript libraries are client libraries for apps, not a way to install the runtime, and nothing in the pack documents package-manager distribution of Ollama.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the runtime quickly using a standard package manager
